ignoreValues.reason: The 3px category stripe is the app's inherited identity, carried over from the LifeRPG desktop build, and it is the only place a habit's category is encoded as colour. In a zero-radius monochrome UI with no other chrome it is the load-bearing signal, not decoration. Reviewed and kept deliberately.

Inter is self-hosted via @fontsource-variable/inter specifically because the desktop build's Google Fonts @import was blocked by CSP and silently never loaded. Swapping the typeface is a redesign, out of scope for an audit-and-polish pass, and would re-open a solved offline-loading problem.
